trajectory_messages.content:
I'm working on the remote agent configuration system.

*   When a remote agent YAML frontmatter contains an auth section with type 'oauth' (not 'oauth2'), the agent loader must parse it successfully and return an auth object with type equal to 'oauth'

*   When parsing a remote agent with OAuth auth that includes optional fields (client_id, client_secret, scopes, authorization_url, token_url), all fields must be preserved in the parsed output alongside type 'oauth'

*   A minimal OAuth auth config containing only the type field set to 'oauth' (with no other fields) must be accepted as valid

*   When an OAuth auth config contains an invalid (non-URL) value for authorization_url, parsing must fail with a validation error, regardless of the auth type being 'oauth'

*   When an OAuth auth config contains an invalid (non-URL) value for token_url, parsing must fail with a validation error, regardless of the auth type being 'oauth'

*   The markdownToAgentDefinition conversion function must accept an auth config with type 'oauth' as a TypeScript string literal and pass it through correctly in the resulting agent definition


**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.
I'll explore the codebase to understand the remote agent configuration system.

**`packages/core/src/agents/auth-provider/types.ts`**
- Added `'oauth'` to the `A2AAuthProviderType` union
- Added a new `OAuthAuthConfig` interface (`type: 'oauth'` with the same optional fields as OAuth2: `client_id`, `client_secret`, `scopes`, `authorization_url`, `token_url`)
- Added it to the `A2AAuthConfig` union

**`packages/core/src/agents/agentLoader.ts`**
- Added `'oauth'` to the `FrontmatterAuthConfig.type` union (so `markdownToAgentDefinition` accepts `type: 'oauth'` as a TS string literal)
- Added `oauthAuthSchema` with `type: z.literal('oauth')`, with `authorization_url`/`token_url` validated via `.url()` (invalid URLs fail validation) and all other fields optional (minimal `type`-only config is valid)
- Registered `oauthAuthSchema` in the `authConfigSchema` discriminated union
- Added an `'oauth'` case in `convertFrontmatterAuthToConfig` that preserves all fields alongside `type: 'oauth'`

**`packages/core/src/agents/auth-provider/factory.ts`**
- Handled the new `'oauth'` case alongside `'oauth2'` (normalizing to the `oauth2` shape for the provider), keeping the exhaustive `never` check compiling.
